title: 第2章
content_zh:
这个冬天漫长，飘了几场雪，树啊，房子啊，白了几次头，又都露出本来的模样。
妈隔三差五得去市里的医院，她没什么劲头说话，恹恹的，人走了，屋里的药气不散，像是要把房子腌了才作罢。
家家户户开始往地窖里存白菜，展有庆在矿上下井，没人帮忙，奶奶又开始骂人，说自己命苦。
说话的是西门石头大爷，石头大爷个子高，七十的人了，还有一身力气，他没了婆娘，婆娘死的早，留下个傻儿子，不曾娶妻，就爷俩守着三间破房子过。
什么婚丧嫁娶要起灶啦，洗盘子啦，上菜啦，石头大爷手脚麻利，不输年轻人，展颜喜欢石头大爷，妈也总夸石头大爷最仁义。
“颜颜，快去上学吧，你看日头都往西走了。”石头大爷一开口，劲儿可真足。
爷爷正守着炉子烤馍，听见动静，赶紧出来：“颜颜，夜里冷得再拿床被子。”
初三功课紧，学校开了晚自习，又弄了几间空教室当寝室，不是镇上的学生可以住校。展颜住了，铺的还是秋天的被褥，她冷，就把衣裳全盖被子上，还是冷，辗转反侧一夜夜，衣裳总掉。
腊月的风，像是远古寒荒时代刮来的，骨头缝都疼，这个爷爷怎么会不知道，他给展颜自行车后头绑了被子，用的麻绳，捆得死死的。
“爷爷，你说我妈过了年天暖和了能好吗？”展颜站在风里，头发参差，已经长长了。
展有庆不爱说话，展颜一年到两头也跟爸说不了几句，他只知道下井，下井挣钱，挣了钱就给妈买肉，买衣裳，还买书。书买的太多了，放不下，他给妈打了个书架，自己动手，槐木的，拙笨但扎实。
展颜推自行车出了家门，等上了路，风灌过来，简直能把人噎死。路边有小孩子在滚铁环，瞎跑一气，她没躲及，连人带车栽沟里去了。
她晕了一瞬，很快爬起来，车轮子径自转着，她呆呆看了片刻，忽然就哭了。
四周全都是死了的东西，死了的植被，死了的土地，不远处就有坟，稀稀疏疏，散在田间，埋着死了的人。
“天哪，展颜？”孙晚秋今天也得迟到，她蹬的急，本来都骑过去了，觉得沟里人眼熟，又折回来。
content_en:
This winter has been long, with several snowfalls. The trees and houses have turned gray several times, but they all show their original appearance.
My mother had to go to the hospital in the city every now and then. She had no energy to talk and was so sleepy that when people left, the medicine in the room lingered, as if she wanted to pickle the house before she gave up.
Every household began to store cabbage in the cellar. Zhan Youqing went up and down the mine with no one to help. Grandma started to curse again, saying that her life was miserable.
The speaker was Uncle Ximen Shitou. Uncle Shitou was tall, seventy years old, and still had a lot of strength. He lost his wife, who died early, leaving behind a stupid son who never married a wife, so the two of them lived in three shabby houses.
Weddings and funerals have to start, wash the dishes, and serve the dishes. Uncle Shitou is as agile as any young man. Zhanyan likes Uncle Shitou, and his mother always praises him as the most benevolent and righteous person.
"Yanyan, go to school quickly. Look, the sun is going west." Uncle Shitou spoke with great energy.
Grandpa was guarding the stove baking buns. When he heard the noise, he came out quickly: "Yan Yan, it's too cold at night to get a quilt."
In the third grade of junior high school, homework was tight. The school opened evening self-study sessions and made several empty classrooms available as dormitories. Students who were not from the town could live on campus. Zhanyan was sleeping, and the autumn quilt was spread out. She was cold, so she put all her clothes on the quilt. She was still cold, and she tossed and turned all night, and her clothes kept falling off.
The wind of the twelfth lunar month was like blowing from the ancient cold and famine era, making the joints of the bones hurt. How could this grandfather not know that he tied a quilt to the back of Zhanyan's bicycle with hemp rope and tied it tightly.
"Grandpa, do you think my mother will be okay after the New Year's day warms up?" Zhanyan stood in the wind, her hair was uneven and had grown long.
Zhan Youqing doesn't like to talk, and Zhan Yan can't even speak to his father for most of the year. He only knows how to go down to the well to make money. When he earns money, he buys meat, clothes, and books for his mother. He bought too many books and couldn't put them down, so he built a bookshelf for his mother and made it himself. It was made of locust wood, clumsy but solid.
Zhanyan pushed the bicycle out of the house, and when he got on the road, the wind came over him, which could make people choke to death. There were children rolling hoops on the side of the road, running blindly, but she didn't hide in time, and they and the car fell into a ditch.
She fainted for a moment, then quickly got up. The wheels were spinning. She stared blankly for a moment, and then suddenly started crying.
There are dead things, dead vegetation, and dead land all around. There are graves not far away, scattered in the fields, where dead people are buried.
"Oh my god, show your face?" Sun Wanqiu had to be late today too. She was pedaling so fast that she had already ridden past, but she thought the people in the ditch looked familiar, so she turned back.
